title: Hair Regeneration Clinics Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Hair Regeneration Clinics: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Hair Regeneration Clinics — clinics restoring hair via follicle regeneration.

Phase 1 — Prove (follicle labs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (clinic logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (stem activation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (scalp mapping): clinic hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and dermatology-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
